sources.entry: GPM - macOS application for easily operating GitHub Projects.

summary.one_liner: GPM is a macOS application for easily operating GitHub Projects.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short. It describes GPM as a macOS app for working with GitHub Projects. It states a limitation: only 30 cards per column can be seen, due to API limits. It lists Mac OS X 10.11 or later as the requirement. It gives build steps using Carthage and Xcode. It is MIT licensed. The README does not describe specific features beyond this.
use_cases: manage GitHub Projects boards on a Mac
view GitHub Projects cards on macOS
build a macOS GitHub Projects client from source
notable: Native macOS app for GitHub Projects
Built with Xcode and Carthage dependencies
caveats: Shows at most 30 cards per column because of GitHub API limits
Requires Mac OS X 10.11 or later
README is minimal and gives no feature details
